title: •Mace Windu
caption: •Mace Windu (V)
game_text: Deploys -2 to same site as a Jedi. Mace’s game text may not be canceled and he may fire one weapon twice per battle. Boba Fett may not add battle destiny draws here. Once per game, may ▲ Blaster Deflection. Immune to attrition.
lore: Senior *Jedi Council member* who maintains rigorous adherence to the Code. Sent Qui-Gon to Naboo to accompany the Queen and learn more about the mysterious “dark warrior.”

notes: Unique. Stats POWER 6 / ABILITY 7 / JEDI MASTER (label only); deploy 8 / forfeit 8 (printed 6 / 7). Icon column: warrior only. Light Jedi Master (Coruscant frame, blue-blade Jedi Master disc; Episode I frame — art_trim may apply). The printed card shows the Coruscant ring AND an Episode I icon below it beside the lore box. ▲ where the stub expands the phrase. Margin credits (each printed on two lines on the slip): left 'Original concept by / Zane Thorp', right 'Texas State / Winner 2004'. Lore corrected from the scan and the 745 px V1 remake: 'Jedi Council member' is BOLD; curly double quotes with the period inside: “dark warrior.” (wiki straight single quotes, period outside). Base scan only at 350 px (Cor-L-macewindu.gif, not the _ai alternate image); copyright per the Coruscant convention. Modern: V1-L-macewindu.gif (745 px); VB5 -pre also exists, not downloaded.
